outline:
本課程期透過建立學生正確的研究觀念，以培養論文研究與寫作之基礎能力。根據論文寫作方法之需求，讓學生了解研究方法的本質、研究的意義、過程與方法，以及研究設計的基本概念與特性；進而瞭解如何進行質性與量化研究、資料蒐集、資料處理與統計分析，並瞭解論文格式及架構，學習撰寫研究論文並準備口頭報告，並透過課堂互動互動與分享，強化學習。
The objectives of this course are：1. To introduce the basic concept of research methodology that applies in academic and practical research. 2. To learn the methods of conducting research processes and preparing research proposals and reports. 3. To know how to obtain the required information through appropriate approaches in writing thesis or  research reports and solving management problems.
assessment:
class participation  50%
case discussion and presentation  50%
